title: Measured runtime selection
responsibility: Chooses the simplest runtime within tolerance of the fastest matching cold-latency measurement and explains omitted candidates.

inputs.name: chooseRuntime.input
inputs.description: Available measurements plus the exact workload and machine profile to consider. Only latency-cold-ms entries for those labels participate.

outputs.name: chooseRuntime
outputs.description: Chosen runtime, measured or unmeasured basis, workload and profile, selection rule, candidates and exclusions. Module, Wasm and process are considered in that order within five percent of the fastest; no winner falls back to unmeasured module. HTTP is never selected automatically.
